name: @fdsh-utils/spec-medh-nsc
description: OpenAPI and JSON Schema source files for the MEDH NSC service.

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:openapi && pnpm run validate:schemas
scripts.bundle: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle openapi.yml --output openapi.bundled.yml
scripts.validate:schemas: sh -c 'set -- schemas/*.schema.json; if [ -e "$1" ]; then for schema in "$@"; do ajv compile --spec=draft2020 -s "$schema"; done; else echo "No JSON Schema files found"; fi'
